chapter.title: Time
chapter.para: A guest keeps its own time, from the timers that the hypervisor gives it.

section.para: On x86_64 the hypervisor shall give the guest a clock of the time stamp counter, which runs without intervention and starts at 0 when the VM starts.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: JetOS for x86_64 takes its system time from the time stamp counter.

section.para: On x86_64 the hypervisor shall emulate for each VM the 8254 timer with its three channels, their modes and their access modes, the counter latch and the read-back command, and port B (the gate of channel 2, the speaker bit, the refresh toggle and the output of channel 2).

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: JetOS for x86_64 uses channel 0 for its tick and channel 2 to measure the time stamp counter.

section.para: On x86_64 the hypervisor shall give the guest IRQ 0 at the rate programmed for channel 0 of its 8254 timer, by the timer of the local APIC, dropping the interrupts that the guest has missed.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: JetOS for x86_64 takes its tick from channel 0, and a guest that was late must not get a burst of ticks.

section.para: On arm64 the hypervisor shall give the guest the virtual timer and the virtual counter of its CPU, the counter starting at 0 when the VM starts.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: JetOS for arm64 takes its system time and its tick from them.

section.para: On arm64 the hypervisor shall deliver the interrupt of the virtual timer to the guest through the virtual CPU interface.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: JetOS for arm64 takes its system time and its tick from them.

section.para: On arm64 the hypervisor shall emulate for each VM a PL031 real-time clock that gives the time of the host.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: JetOS for arm64 takes its calendar time from the PL031.

section.para: The hypervisor shall, when it starts, measure the frequencies of the time stamp counter and of the local APIC timer against the 8254 timer and stop with a message if it cannot measure them (x86_64), or read the frequency of the system counter (arm64).

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: Delays and the rate of the tick of a guest depend on them.
